# Makeovers by Niki - Luxury Bridal Makeup Artist

> Makeovers by Niki is a premier luxury bridal & destination wedding makeup studio led by celebrity makeup artist Niki Gurnani. Based in India, Niki provides high-fashion HD and airbrush bridal makeup transformations for elite destination weddings across India, Dubai, Italy, and globally.

## Core Services
- **Luxury Bridal Makeup**: Bespoke high-definition and airbrush bridal makeup tailored for royal, traditional, and contemporary aesthetics.
- **Destination Weddings**: Comprehensive international travel makeup protocols for weddings in Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, Dubai, Lake Como, and worldwide.
- **Engagement & Reception Styling**: Curated pre-wedding and post-wedding hair and makeup transformations.
